recent.text: “He has so many intangibles that it is hard to keep him off the floor.” Bickerstaff speaks on Javonte Green’s performance against the Pelicans, where he finished with 18 points, seven rebounds, two steals and a block the win. #Pistons https://t.co/6uZ8HNDsfB
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: FINAL: Pistons 122, Pelicans 109. With Cade Cunningham out, seven Pistons reached double figures. They improve to 10-4 overall. Collins: 20 pts, 7 rebs (4-6 from 3) Green: 18 pts, 7 rebs Jenkins: 17 pts, 9 assts Reed: 17 pts, 7 rebs, 2 blk Joe, Huerter: 11 pts Thompson: 10 pts
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Final: #Pistons 122, Pelicans 109 Collins 20 pts, 7 rebs Green: 18 pts, 7 rebs Jenkins: 17 pts, 9 asts
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: Reed nearly had a great bounce pass to Huerter, but he couldn't covert. Huerter made up for it the next possession, setting up an alley-oop to Green. Pistons 101, Pelicans 88 with 9:10 to go. Biggest lead yet
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Huerter finds Green for a one-handed alley-oop. #Pistons up 101-88 over the Pelicans with 9:10 left in the fourth quarter.
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: Chaz Lanier triple good. He has scored nine points on 3-for-4 shooting from deep so far tonight.
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: End of 3: Pistons 92, Pelicans 86. Jenkins: 15 pts, 7 assts Green: 13 pts, 6 rebs, 2 stls Reed: 13 pts (6-7 ovr), 5 rebs Collins: 13 pts, 3-5 from 3 Thompson: 10 pts, 4 rebs, 4 assts, 2 stls
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: End of 3rd: #Pistons 92, Pelicans 86 Jenkins: 15 pts, 7 asts Collins: 13 pts Joe: 11 pts (first game back since Oct. 25 vs. the Sixers)
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: Isaiah Joe has 11 points and three 3s. After a slow start and injury, he looks like himself again
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Collins has 13 points and three 3's. Finding his spots tonight
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Halftime: Pistons 67, Hornets 60. Jenkins (13 pts, 3-4 from 3) and Green (13 pts, 5-6 overall, 2 steals) have been a strong starting backcourt. Reed has 10 off the bench on 5-5 shooting. Joe (5 pts, 2 assts) has made an impact in his return. Pistons are shooting 10-18 from 3.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Halftime: #Pistons 67, Pelicans 60 Jenkins: 13 pts, 5 asts Green: 13 pts, 4 rebs Reed: 10 pts
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: Isaiah Joe connects with Tolu Smith for a layup-alley. The #Pistons are currently on an 11-2 run to take their biggest lead of the night, 57-48 over the Pelicans with 3:21 left in the second quarter.
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: Wow, that was a dime from Harkless. He has 3 assists and 0 turnovers in 4 minutes
